title: research: R439 sub-10k six-way composition (9,974 ADDs), whole-A star duals, and UT4/dyadic floors
body:
# [bit-helper-contract / bit-new-register-model] Sub-10,000-ADD Six-Way `r439` Composition (`9,974` ADDs) and Exact Dual Witnesses across Star-Edge, `UT_4(F_2)`, and Dyadic Borel Models

- **Primary Task:** `bit-helper-contract` (`docs/research/current-priorities.md`, priority revision `6`, portfolio weight `10%`, `scope_status: "unchanged"`, `actual_scope`: `"Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?"`)
- **Secondary Task:** `bit-new-register-model` (`docs/research/current-priorities.md`, priority revision `6`, portfolio weight `10%`)
- **Selected Global Upper Bound (Unchanged):** `kappa <= 0.001672660197076918` (**PR #1094**, `certificates/selected-result.json`). This package is a local structural witness and exact obstruction study on the `r439` (`4-4-20`) straight-line witness ladder and idealized register models; it does **not** alter the selected global `kappa` bound (`no_new_kappa`).
- **Archival Intake Base Status:** The `r439` (`4-4-20`) witness baseline (**PR #589**, `24,305` ADDs) and its local optimization and obstruction lineage (**PR #1062**, **PR #1122**, **PR #1188**, **PR #1194**, **PR #1311**, **PR #1384**, **PR #1507**, **PR #1543**, **PR #1709**, **PR #1803**, **PR #1806**, **PR #1868**, **PR #1937**, **PR #2107**, **PR #2115**, **PR #2440**, **PR #2613**, **PR #2828**, **PR #2977**, and external comparators **PR #2408**, **PR #2374**, **PR #2316**, **PR #2312**) carry `"merged_for_archive_only"` and `"partially_reviewed"` status in `docs/research/pr-intake-decisions.json`; every cited prior result is treated strictly as a `"report (author-checked)"` (plural: `"reports (author-checked)"`).
- **Package Path:** `research/r439-sub10k-sixway-and-star-dual-witnesses`
- **Base Commit:** `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`
- **Author:** `dcharb78, with AI assistance`
- **One-Command Verification:** `/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12 -B research/r439-sub10k-sixway-and-star-dual-witnesses/verify.py` (~`4.4` seconds, Python 3.12 standard library only)

---

## Summary of Contributions

This package directly addresses the Track 1 (`bit-mechanisms`, 20% combined portfolio weight in `docs/research/current-priorities.md` across `bit-helper-contract` and `bit-new-register-model`) priority question:

> *"Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?"*

Through four coupled, deterministically verified pillars (`verify.py` -> `RESULT.json`), this package establishes a **constructive sub-10,000-ADD breakthrough (`9,974` ADDs)** on the actual `r439` (`4-4-20`) 661-column witness ladder while certifying **three unconditional structural impossibility barriers** across the star-edge, `F_2[UT_4(F_2)]`, and dyadic block-Borel register models:

1. **Pillar 1 — First Sub-10,000-ADD Constructive Witness on the `r439` (`4-4-20`) Ladder (`9,974` ADDs, `-518` vs. PR #1188, `-74` vs. PR #2440):**
   We verify from pinned verification inputs that **PR #1543** (`research/r439-neutral-helper-chain-seed17`, `-11` ADDs) and **PR #1709** (`research/r439-five-cycle-seed9f01`, `-12` ADDs) commute with **PR #1868** (`research/r439-twisted-star-absorption-seed02`, `-3` ADDs) and **PR #2115** (`research/r439-deferred-target-basis-seed06`, `-433` ADDs) on **PR #1188** (`research/r439-gl5-shortest`, `10,492` ADDs) to form 4-Way Composition A (`10,045` / `10045` ADDs) and 4-Way Composition B (`10,044` / `10044` ADDs), and that combining **PR #1709 + PR #1868 + PR #2115** with **PR #2440** (`research/r439-one-slot-multicolumn-interleave`, 10-pair target-`445` scatter reducing `scatter_ADDs` from `94` to `84`) yields a **5-way composition at `10,034` ADDs** (`10034`). We then identify **6 new pairwise-disjoint middle-column helper shears** (`(a_local, b_local)` = `(127, 240)`, `(16, 239)`, `(121, 128)`, `(422, 371)`, `(3, 235)`, `(238, 29)`) that wrap the middle-column section-`D` window `[lo_m=472 .. hi_m=569]` with `12` setup/restore gates and save `14 + 11 + 10 + 9 + 8 + 8 = 60` ADDs (`w_b' = popcount(col[b] ^ col[a]) = w_b + w_a - 2k`, `net_saving = w_b - w_b' - 2`, reducing total `b`-weight across the 6 pairs from `85` to `13`). The resulting **6-way witness achieves `9,974` ADDs** (`9974`, `F = 15,539` / `15539`, `B = 2,830,702` / `2830702`, `scatter_ADDs = 84`, `paid_rank_mass = 5,129` / `5129`) and passes 100% of the 661-column forward/reverse replays, the `91`-bit local evaluator, and the `174`-bit 9-stage evaluator.
2. **Pillar 2 — Whole-Section-`A` and Coupled `(a, c)` Star-Edge Absorption Theorem (`693` + `675` Explicit RREF Dual Hyperplane Witnesses):**
   Across all three canonical `r439` star-factored words (**PR #1062** `research/r439-bsection-stars-seed01` at `11,500` ADDs, **PR #1122** `research/r439-abc-star-composition` at `10,652` ADDs, and **PR #1188** `research/r439-gl5-shortest` at `10,492` ADDs), each word has `236` B-section star edges (`5` solvable edges `(506, 374), (507, 355), (514, 367), (264, 536), (326, 530)` and `231` obstructed edges). Removing the reader-horizon (`r_0`) barrier completely—allowing arbitrary monotone `a`-writes across the **entire section `A` (`[0, |A|]`)** and arbitrary coupled `(a, c)` writes across both section `A` and section `C`—yields **`0` additional solvable star edges** (`5 / 236` solvable, `231 / 236` obstructed). `verify.py` constructs and verifies all **`693`** (`3 * 231`) explicit 661-bit RREF dual hyperplane witnesses and all **`675`** (`3 * 225`) explicit 1,322-bit coupled `(a, c)` RREF dual witnesses.
3. **Pillar 3 — Unconditional All-Length, All-Role `n_b >= 6` Theorem in `F_2[UT_4(F_2)]`:**
   Prior **PR #1803** / **PR #1806** (`research/ut4-fifteen-call-five-b`) and **PR #2828** (`research/bit-ut4-mixed-targets-barrier`, `"merged_for_archive_only"`, `"partially_reviewed"`) report (author-checked) that `n_b = 5` middle calls fail at fixed total lengths `13` (`(4, 5, 4)`) and `15` (`(5, 5, 5)`). By proving across all **`256` (`256 / 256`)** endpoint pairs `(S_a, S_c)` that the reachable central accumulator fiber in each gap is the exact 3-dimensional affine trace hyperplane `{q in M_2(F_2) : Tr(q) = Tr(S_a S_c)}`, we evaluate all **`3,600` (`3600`)** zero-sum 5-`b` middles across **all unconstrained prefix-sum profiles `(p_0, ..., p_4) in M_2(F_2)^5`**. Across all **`3,240` (`3240`)** non-degenerate middles (`rank X_b = rank Y_b = 2`), **`0`** (`ut4_nondegenerate_compatible_pairs = 0`) length-unconstrained `(a, c)` profile pairs exist at **any finite word length `L` and any role count `m >= 3`**. Across the `360` degenerate middles (`rank X_b = 1` or `rank Y_b = 1`), only **`16`** middles (`3,145,728` / `3145728` profile pairs across minimal realizable lengths `L in {13, ..., 27}`) survive the trace screen, and **100% (`3,145,728 / 3,145,728`)** identically annihilate `ACB[0, 0] = 0` or `BAC[0, 0] = 0`.
4. **Pillar 4 — Full 4x4 Block-Borel Schubert-Cell Invariance and 3-Call Parity Floor (`mW = 4`):**
   Prior **PR #1507**, **PR #2107**, **PR #2613** (`research/bit-full-borel-2adic-floor`), and **PR #2977** (`research/paired-diagonal-borel-gauge`, `"merged_for_archive_only"`, `"partially_reviewed"`) report (author-checked) a 2-call trace obstruction, a restricted dyadic Gram/Schubert FAQ, a 2-adic valuation floor, and a paired-diagonal Borel gauge analysis. Lifting these to the **full 4x4 block-Borel group** (`B_full`, including arbitrary strictly lower-block cleanup shears `L_{21} in M_2(F_2)`), `verify.py` verifies exact Schubert-cell invariance across **`40,593` (`40593`)** free block-Borel checks (`13,531` planes across `O_0, O_1, O_2`), verifies `Delta c <= 1` across **`54,124` (`54124`)** rank-1 shear checks, and exhaustively tests all **`20,224` (`20224`)** 3-call `(1 + 1 + 2)` parity configurations, finding **`0` survivors** (`dyadic_3call_parity_survivors = 0`) achieving `E_2 = I_2` and `E_1 = 0`, certifying the paid-rank floor **`mW = 4` (`dyadic_paid_rank_floor = 4`)** at `m = 2, W = 2`.

## Single-Move Behavioral Negative Controls (`controls = 6`)

`verify.py` enforces 6 explicit behavioral negative controls (all recorded in `RESULT.json["controls"]`):

1. **`control_1_overlapping_seventh_shear_corrupts_661_semantics`:** Appending an overlapping 7th middle-column shear (`349 ^= 461`, reusing `a_wire = 349` from Shear 1) without updating coupled middle-column target supports corrupts `2` output registers in the 661-column forward replay.
2. **`control_2_omitting_shear1_prep_or_undo_gate_breaks_targets`:** Omitting the 2 setup/restore gates of Shear 1 (`349 ^= 462`) while retaining the sheared middle-column reads breaks `62` output registers across the `16` shared middle-column target wires.
3. **`control_3_dual_hyperplane_witness_validation_and_corrupted_dual_rejection`:** All `693` whole-section-`A` 661-bit RREF dual hyperplane witnesses and `675` coupled `(a, c)` 1,322-bit RREF dual witnesses pass exact orthogonality (`u^T M = 0, u^T target = 1`), all `693` target-flipped dual witnesses are rejected, and `0` of the `5` solvable edges per word are falsely obstructed.
4. **`control_4_ut4_degenerate_rank1_middle_annihilates_acb00_or_bac00`:** Relaxing the non-degeneracy hypothesis (`rank X_b = rank Y_b = 2`) in `F_2[UT_4(F_2)]` admits `16` degenerate zero-sum 5-`b` middles (`3,145,728` profile pairs), 100% (`3,145,728 / 3,145,728`) of which identically annihilate `ACB[0, 0] = 0` or `BAC[0, 0] = 0`.
5. **`control_5_ut4_omitting_any_call_from_direct_464_word_fails`:** Omitting any 1 of the `14` calls from the direct `(4, 6, 4)` formal `UT_4(F_2)` witness fails the 192-column formal target identity (`14 / 14` rejected).
6. **`control_6_dyadic_borel_single_block_and_illegal_upper_shear`:** A single rank-2 call (`paid_rank = 2`) has maximum `F_2`-rank `1 < 2` on `E_2`, whereas an illegal free upper shear `H -> D` jumps `V_D` directly to Schubert cell `O_2` at `paid_rank = 0`.

## Open next questions

1. **Joint Coupled Multi-Shear Basis Optimization Below `9,974` ADDs:** Can a non-disjoint (triangular/cascaded) middle-column helper-shear sequence in `[lo_m, hi_m]` absorb overlapping `B`-wires whose residual weights (`b_weight_after in {2, 3, 6}`) are currently non-zero, pushing the `r439` (`4-4-20`) witness below `9,900` ADDs?
2. **Deferred-Scatter Absorption Beyond the Remaining `84` Scatter ADDs:** Can simultaneous basis retargeting across section `D` and section `C` absorb additional high-fanout middle-column targets beyond target `445` (`research/r439-one-slot-multicolumn-interleave`) without increasing `B`-section star reads?
3. **Six-`b` (`n_b = 6`) Minimum Total Length Below `14` Calls in `F_2[UT_4(F_2)]`:** With `n_b <= 5` unconditionally excluded at all finite word lengths `L` and all role counts `m >= 3`, does a `13`-call word with `n_b = 6` (`(3, 6, 4)` or `(4, 6, 3)`) exist in `F_2[UT_4(F_2)]`, or is `L = 14` (`(4, 6, 4)`) the unconditional all-length minimum across all `n_b >= 6`?
